import json
N=27
g=[[4]*N for _ in range(N)]
for i in range(N): g[13][i]=1; g[i][13]=1
# Source motif, 3x3 tiles, tile size 2
P=[[None,3,6],[8,8,2],[None,1,1]]
def stamp(n, anchor_r, anchor_c, flip_v=False, flip_h=False):
    q=[row[:] for row in P]
    if flip_v: q=q[::-1]
    if flip_h: q=[row[::-1] for row in q]
    ar=2-1 if flip_v else 1
    ac=2-2 if flip_h else 2
    r0=anchor_r-ar*n; c0=anchor_c-ac*n
    for tr,row in enumerate(q):
        for tc,col in enumerate(row):
            if col is None: continue
            for dr in range(n):
                for dc in range(n):
                    r=r0+tr*n+dr; c=c0+tc*n+dc
                    if 0<=r<N and 0<=c<N and r!=13 and c!=13:
                        g[r][c]=col
# source template (tile size 2) at origin row3,col1
for tr,row in enumerate(P):
    for tc,col in enumerate(row):
        if col is None: continue
        for dr in range(2):
            for dc in range(2): g[3+tr*2+dr][1+tc*2+dc]=col
# target marker anchors
stamp(3,4,19,flip_h=True)
stamp(1,21,5,flip_v=True)
stamp(4,19,18,flip_v=True,flip_h=True)
print(json.dumps(g))
